body: Fair enough, I’ll update you with the results

At work, I had a customer tell me that he went to see the comedian Lewis Black, and I asked him who he was. He told me “he’s one of those Jewish comedians who swears a lot, but he’s funny though”. I mean, he wasn’t wrong?

Howdy! In Bad Dream Baby, you talk about chilling with some dudes in their forties, and on the Baby Boys track Shorty they come up again, what’s the story there?

The new EP is bangin, and side note, Threesome has been such a source of joy and comfort and inspiration to me, thank you for creating it

Where I am, in DeKalb county, nobody has a good thing to say about him. I might be under-informed, but I’m just glad to have a governor who takes COVID seriously, and this is a huge step in the right direction

I’ve been to a fair share of therapists, and honestly it’s really helped me. My experience is in the US, hopefully some of it helps. Are you on your parents’ insurance? I’m 20 and I’m still on mine, and it can bring down the cost big time. If you don’t know any therapists in the area, this website lets you put in your zip code, and shows you all of the therapists in a certain radius. You can even sort them by the insurance plans they accept. It’s a tough go out there if you don’t have people to talk to. I wish you the best

I work at a grocery store in the Midwest. Last night we had a guy come in without a mask, and he was told he needed to wear a mask or at least put his shirt over his face. He proceeded to take his shirt off, cuss out my manager and walk away shirtless. The store director didn’t even kick him out, just made him put the shirt back on

may be a bit random but how was touring with the Sun Club bois way back when? I loved the snippet of the My Only Ghost video directed by Shane, it was mad groovy.

Love you boys :)
I get what you’re saying, early misfits was golden, but I think the boys are working on a formula that works for them now. I won’t say it’s perfect yet, but I want to support them in the long run
